summary: Executed full backend + frontend testing of the new Audit Log feature. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_audit_log.py (24 tests, single class, cleans up after itself): 21 passed, 2 failed, 1 skipped (the skipped case was re-proven with a direct probe). Verified event emission for login success/failure, the new auth.login.password_ok -> 2FA -> auth.login.success split, 2FA challenge success/failure, client + admin document upload/view/download/delete, scenario create/update/delete, term-sheet submit/status_change/delete/view, admin invites (create-only + send), password-reset request success/failure, admin 2FA reset, RBAC (401/403/200), all query filters incl. regex-escaped q, date_to end-of-day inclusivity, pagination (60 dummy events, 25/page x3), event-types catalog (23 incl. password_ok), CSV export headers/filename/content-type/limit, X-Forwarded-For first-hop IP extraction, and log_event error swallowing. Frontend /admin/audit-log verified end-to-end with Playwright (load, sidebar link, dropdown, filters, clear, special-char search, date filter, detail modal content, CSV download, pagination show/hide + next/prev, empty state, client RBAC redirect). 3 real defects found: document.delete audit rows lose the filename, CSV export is silently truncated at 500 rows, and the Details modal renders off-screen because of a stale CSS transform on the admin layout wrapper.

critical.issue: document.delete audit events always have resource_name=null. server.py:1831 and 3095 look up the file meta with `fm.get("id") == file_id`, but _append_file_to_doc (server.py:2727) stores the key as `file_id`. Chain-of-custody therefore never records WHICH file was deleted (only metadata.file_id). Fix: `fm.get("file_id") == file_id`. Reproduced by tests 06 and 07 (both FAILED).

Export is silently capped at 500 rows regardless of `limit` (documented default 10000, hard max 50000). audit_service.query_events clamps page_size = max(1, min(page_size, 500)), and export passes limit as page_size. Proven: inserted 600 matching events, requested limit=5000 -> CSV returned exactly 500 data rows with no warning. A compliance export of a busy log will silently omit data. Fix: give query_events a `max_page_size`/`hard_cap` parameter (or iterate/cursor for export).

minor.issue: page_size is silently clamped to 500 (request page_size=600 -> page_size echoed 500). Acceptable, but undocumented in the response; consider returning the applied cap explicitly.
Lender term-sheet document upload writes to term_sheet_files but emits NO audit event, while every other upload path does. Spec says record every upload.
No side-effect issue with audit, but note the endpoint always resets and always logs even when the target had 2FA disabled (no-op events pollute the log). Low priority.

ui_bugs.issue: Details modal is invisible to the user. The modal uses `fixed inset-0`, but its ancestor `div.max-w-6xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-10 fade-up` has a lingering `transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)` from the fade-up animation, which makes it the containing block for position:fixed. Measured: overlay box = {x:514, y:24, w:1152, h:3369} and modal card box = {x:754, y:1467, w:672, h:503} at a 1080px viewport -> clicking 'Details' just dims the content column and the dialog sits ~1500px below the fold. Side effects: backdrop does not cover the sidebar, backdrop click over the sidebar does nothing, and while open the overlay intercepts pointer events over Export CSV / Apply / pagination so the page appears frozen. Fix: render the modal through a React portal to document.body (or set transform:none / animation-fill-mode so .fade-up leaves no transform).

issues: From/To use native browser date inputs (type="date", mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere in the product
Filter field labels are 10px uppercase #6B6558 on #FBF8F1 — legible but at the low end of contrast/size for a compliance screen

action_items: Fix file-meta key lookup (`fm.get("file_id")`) at server.py:1831 and server.py:3095 so document.delete records the filename
Remove the 500-row clamp for CSV export (add a hard_cap/max_page_size arg to audit_service.query_events) so limit up to 50000 actually works
Portal the audit-log Details modal to document.body (or kill the .fade-up transform) so the dialog is viewport-centered and the backdrop covers the sidebar
Add a document.upload audit event to POST /api/lender/scenarios/{sid}/term-sheet/upload
Optional: swap the From/To native date inputs for the shadcn calendar component
critical_code_review_comments: audit_service.query_events is reused for both paginated listing and CSV export but hard-clamps page_size to 500 — export correctness depends on a UI-oriented guard. Separate the two code paths.
server.py is 10.6k lines; the audit-log admin endpoints (~3272-3355) and the instrumented handlers would be easier to maintain in a router module.

Deleted-file audit metadata relies on an ad-hoc `next(...)` lookup duplicated in two places with a wrong key — extract a `_find_file_meta(doc, file_id)` helper to avoid the drift that caused this bug.
log_event is awaited inline on hot paths (login, file download). It swallows errors correctly, but consider BackgroundTasks/fire-and-forget to avoid adding a Mongo round-trip to every document view.

success_rate.backend: 88% (21/24 pytest cases; 2 failed on document.delete resource_name, 1 skipped and separately proven as the 500-row export cap)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (all flows pass except the off-screen Details modal / backdrop scope)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_audit_log.py` — tests 06 and 07 are the only failures and assert exactly the document.delete resource_name bug; test_19 skips unless >500 audit rows exist (to reproduce the export cap, bulk-insert 600 rows into db.audit_log with a marker email, request export.csv?limit=5000&q=<marker>, expect 500 rows today). audit_log had 81 rows after this run. For the modal bug, measure `page.locator('[data-testid="audit-detail-modal"]').bounding_box()` — y must be < viewport height. RBAC on the frontend correctly bounces clients to /portal.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) document.delete filename loss: file meta dicts are created with the key `file_id` in _append_file_to_doc, but both delete handlers search with `fm.get('id')`, so file_meta is always None and resource_name is null. 2) CSV truncation: export.csv forwards its `limit` as query_events' page_size, which is clamped to 500 by `page_size = max(1, min(page_size, 500))` in audit_service.query_events. 3) Off-screen modal: the .fade-up animation leaves a computed `transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)` on the admin layout content wrapper, creating a containing block for the modal's `position: fixed`, so `inset-0` resolves to the 3369px-tall content column instead of the viewport and the centered card lands ~1467px down the page.
